reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Patient-paired multiomic treatment-associated program discovery, assay-specific preprocessing, primary late integration/enrichment and locked external cohort validation.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution plan to consult original assay Methods, supplements or validated analysis protocols and check their transfer to the present inputs.
The 4,238-word answer materially exceeds the 3,500-word limit.
No explicit specimen-identity or pre/post linkage verification beyond assuming the patient matrices are correct.
No variance-to-patient-level detectable-effect/precision calculation for 30 patients and the small external cohort; stability-based minimum-pair selection is not a power justification.

Feature signs within a biological program are correlated. Marginal probability one-half does not give a binomial count null without independent feature trials; use a patient-level dependence-preserving calibration.

The central integration route lists multilevel PLS, factor models and PCA without defining the chosen transformation/objective/likelihood or how its components distinguish variation in response from mean paired shift.
The one-standard-error criterion is useful, but no bounded sparsity/filter search or procedure deriving the candidate ranges and stop is supplied.

checks.quote: or, if the validation cohort is too small
checks.reason: This acceptance rule allows secondary pathway/sign evidence to validate when the main score test is inadequate, contradicting section 11.5 which calls secondary-only evidence unvalidated. A fixed estimand/test hierarchy and inconclusive outcome are needed.
Code version/seeds are mentioned but input hashes, a pinned environment/commands and stable file/sample/output provenance are missing.
Nested feature/model selection is present, but fitted normalization, scaling, missingness calibration and filtering are not explicitly fitted only inside each training fold.

checks.quote: randomly flip the signs of paired differences
checks.reason: Unrestricted paired swaps/sign flips are not justified when technical batch is linked to time. A conditional/exchangeable null or a restricted identifiable subset is needed.
No clean-environment numerical rerun, table/figure tolerances or resource/failure/source-difference logs.
